## Appearance

Ruby Gillis is a fair young woman known for her long yellow, golden braids of hair, large bright-blue eyes, and a brilliant complexion. Originally characterized by a plump and showy figure with snap and color, her appearance later changes as she becomes very thin. In addition, her blue eyes take on a bright, lustrous sheen, and her cheeks display a hectically brilliant color.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful, good-tempered individual who enjoys life's pleasantries, though she is prone to hysterics and harbors a mortal dread of fat green caterpillars. Driven by a desire for romance, her long-held ambition is to have a multitude of suitors fascinated by her, planning to teach for only two years before marrying and settling down after having a gay time. She is noted for being highly conscious of young men, rarely speaking of anything other than boys and the compliments they give her. Later in life, however, she expresses a profound fear of dying.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis grew up alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), having charmed away all her warts as a young girl using a magic pebble given to her by old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) from the Creek. As a child, she openly expressed her intention to have dozens of beaus when she grew up, and she eventually joined Anne's local story club to cultivate her imagination. She later attended school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) in the same class as [Anne](../character/anne.md). By her early twenties, Ruby became well known in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for her lively social life and frequent flirtations. However, she eventually contracted consumption, a terminal illness that brought about a rapid decline in her health despite her efforts to maintain a cheerful, flirtatious façade. During a visit from [Anne](../character/anne.md), Ruby broke down in her garden and tearfully confessed her deep fear of dying and her yearning to go on living. Shortly after [Anne](../character/anne.md) left her that evening, Ruby passed away peacefully in her sleep, and her friends later gathered for her funeral.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> "I don’t mind floating down when there’s two or three of us in the flat and we can sit up. It’s fun then. But to lie down and pretend I was dead—I just couldn’t. I’d die really of fright."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)

> "It makes me feel frightened, girls. Do you suppose it’s really right to act like this? Mrs. Lynde says that all play-acting is abominably wicked."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013)

> "Anne, it won’t be long now before I’ll be lying over there. You and Diana and all the rest will be going about, full of life—and I’ll be there—in the old graveyard—dead!"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Summons P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007)

> "I’ll try. I’ll think over what you have said, and try to believe it. And you’ll come up as often as you can, won’t you, Anne?"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Summons P21](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0021)

> "There’s a concert at Carmody and a party at White Sands. Herb Spencer’s going to take me. He’s my latest. Be sure to come up tomorrow. I’m dying for a good talk with you. I want to hear all about your doings at Redmond."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Life P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008)
